Natural ordering of levels for character variables

Source: R/helpers.R
natural_levels.Rd

Values starting with a number are sorted numerically by that number (e.g. "3" < "10", "2 doses" < "10 doses") and come first. A leading comparison operator is taken into account: "<10%" comes just before "10%", ">90%" just after "90%" (also "<=", ">=", and the symbols for these). All other values follow alphabetically, with embedded numbers compared numerically ("Arm 2" < "Arm 10"). NA is not a level.

Usage

natural_levels(x)

Arguments

x

A character vector.

Value

Character vector of levels in natural order.
